form_id.description: The survey Form this assignment belongs to

survey_version_id.description: Survey version that was current when the assignment was created (reference only; responses stamp the version actually served)

survey_version_number.description: Version number snapshot at assignment time

event_type.description: Which event table the assignment points at

event_id.description: Simple event id (when event_type = event); nulled if the event is deleted

complex_event_id.description: Complex event id (when event_type = complex_event); nulled if the event is deleted

event_title.description: Event title snapshot so historic results survive rename/archive/delete

opens_at.description: When the assignment starts accepting responses (null = immediately)

closes_at.description: When the assignment stops accepting responses (null = never)

access_mode.description: Whether respondents must be logged-in members

token.description: Unguessable token driving the public assignment URL (/survey/{token})
